saw_lines: Online sunglasses buyers judge the brand in minutes, and many ask how it ships before they click.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where the shipping answer either appears or does not.
Your site explains how orders ship, yet 0 of 30 ads mention it, so put the shipping answer in line one of three new ads.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 28 Oct 2026
points: Your site explains how orders ship, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping or delivery. Buyers check that before they click, so the question goes unanswered and they go elsewhere. Put the shipping answer in line one of three new ads.

Your site explains how frames arrive, yet 0 of 30 ads show it. Sunglasses bought online are often gifts, so buyers want to know the pair arrives intact. Film one of your 14 video ads with the box arriving.

None of your 30 live ads shows a proof number. Buyers picking unfamiliar sunglasses look for a count showing others chose them. Collect one real figure, such as your review count or orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it.
Your site promotes free shipping over $60, yet 0 of 28 ads mention it. A buyer on the fence has no reason to act without that offer in view. Put free shipping over $60 in line one of three new ads.

ads_1: Shipping-first creative for new buyers, with the box arriving and free shipping over $60
